annotations.exact_quote: we propose Steering LVLMs via SAE Latent Directions (SSL), a plug-and-play method based on SAE-derived latent directions to mitigate hallucinations in LVLMs.
annotations.reason_zh: 论文提出SSL方法，直接以减轻LVLMs生成与视觉输入不一致的幻觉为目标。

annotations.exact_quote: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable performance on multimodal tasks.
annotations.reason_zh: LVLMs是论文明确分析、干预和适配内部表征的研究对象，符合大型视觉语言模型定义。

annotations.exact_quote: we leverage sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to identify semantic directions closely associated with faithfulness or hallucination, extracting more precise and disentangled hallucination-related representations.
annotations.reason_zh: 论文用稀疏自编码器从内部激活中提取稀疏潜在方向/表征，属于以潜在特征表示相关结构的稀疏表示方法。
